overall_verdict: At the capped confidence level, PRED-A and PRED-D may be human-gated operational advisories, PRED-B must be held for review, PRED-F is suitable only as a classical-solver warm start, and PRED-C and PRED-E are rejected; the near-ceiling OOD finding and incomplete reporting of flow-voltage-consistency execution prevent any broader assurance claim.
limitations: assess_ood marked the full 3700-bus deployment outOfDist=true at GridSFM-Open scaleHeadroom=0.925 and imposed confidenceCap=0.3 because it is at or near the validated ceiling; overall confidence is limited accordingly.

The 3-bus reduced pocket has not been certified as representative of the full 3700-bus model, and assess_ood used bus count alone; these are reduced-model disposition results, not full-network validation.

Inputs contain no admittance data. list_verification_checks lists flow_voltage_consistency with tolerance consistencyPU=0.05, but the verifier outputs did not explicitly report whether that check ran, so no per-item run/not_run claim can be evidence-backed.

Verifier violation arrays were null when empty. For PRED-C, PRED-E and PRED-F the tools returned element, kind, detail and margin, not separate value and limit fields; numeric values and limits in the reports are quoted from detail without recomputation.
Warm-start timings are single-sample synthetic input values; only PRED-E and PRED-F qualified for evaluate_warm_start, and the tools quantify no timing variance.
No domain hooks or slash commands were available in the live tool list; human approval for actuation is a stated gate, not an observed technical enforcement test.
screen_n1_contingencies was not run because there are no contingency cases in inputs; no N-1 assurance is provided.
This assessment does not execute a classical AC-OPF re-solve or prove optimality; it applies the independent verifier and the requested warm-start timing gate.
